implemented: Consented, idempotent recurring and future-payment enrollment
Charge selection and calendar-anchored installment scheduling
Separate dental scheduler with no inherited water/sewer invoices
Automatic installment commit, card expiry, decline and failure state
Balance caps after concurrent one-time payments
Same-origin plan HTTP APIs and HttpOnly review cookie
One-time task graders reject additional dental plans
Account-to-plan navigation, instrument entry, review, consent, confirmation and cancellation UI
Versioned recurring and future-payment tasks, private graders and Infinity references
synthetic_policy: Manual cycle selection and private eligibility are synthetic; the public configuration contains a default 36-cycle offer, not proof every alternative is offered.
Equal installment rounding, UTC dates and same-day cutoff use deterministic local policies.
Installments cap to remaining selected debt and may fall below enrollment minimum after one-time payments; no overpayment credit is created by scheduled installments.
Successful payment posting and pending reservations are simulated.
Future schedules may coexist with recurring plans; public configuration does not establish this private interaction.
